note: Three anchors. Frame::render_widget and Frame::render_stateful_widget report each call; Terminal::apply_buffer_with_cursor reports the frame boundary immediately after Backend::flush, the only point at which the frame's bytes are on the terminal and a render-commit marker may be written. All behind #[cfg(feature = "std")]: ratatui-core is #![no_std] and gets std only because the ratatui facade enables it. A stateful render is reported here but its state is not: StatefulWidget::State is ?Sized, so it cannot even be downcast — see the ratatui-widgets patch set for where the concrete state is readable.

requires.reason: The dependency's path is machine-specific, so it cannot live in a patch file. The applier writes it into the copy's Cargo.toml, the way the Go probe's generated workspace supplies its module.
